WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.449047 32.929842)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.449047 32.929842)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'service'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.449047 32.929842)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

WITH museum_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-96.449047, 32.929842), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
service_roads AS (
  SELECT 
    geometry AS geom
  FROM 
    roads
  WHERE 
    highway = 'service'
),
nearest_service_road AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_Dump(geom)).geom AS geom
  FROM 
    service_roads
  ORDER BY 
    museum_geom.geom <-> (ST_Dump(geom)).geom
  LIMIT 1
),
museum_to_road_line AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_ShortestLine(museum_geom.geom::geometry, nearest_service_road.geom::geometry) AS line_geom
  FROM 
    museum_geom, nearest_service_road
),
road_elevation_profile AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_3DInterpolatePoints(
      ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, nearest_service_road.geom::geometry, TRUE),
      museum_to_road_line.line_geom,
      'LINESTRING'
    ) AS elevation_profile
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, nearest_service_road, museum_to_road_line
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, nearest_service_road.geom::geometry)
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Length(museum_to_road_line.line_geom) / 1000 AS distance_km,
    ST_3DLength(elevation_profile) - ST_Length(elevation_profile) AS elevation_diff,
    (ST_3DLength(elevation_profile) - ST_Length(elevation_profile)) / ST_Length(elevation_profile) * 100 AS slope_percent_avg
  FROM 
    elevation_profile, museum_to_road_line
)
SELECT 
  'Rockwall County Historical Foundation Museum' AS name,
  distance_km AS distance_km,
  slope_percent_avg AS slope_percent_avg
FROM 
  elevation_stats;
